value.label: Room I / Lamikhai
value.description: Begin on Lamikhai. Place persistent fire meteors at the edge, drag the enraged spider through the friendly Frost Trap, then escape through the opened route before Fiery Eruption resolves.

value.label: Room II / Valinna and Lamikhai
value.description: Valinna introduces Immolation Traps and heavy fire pressure; Lamikhai later returns with its enrage/freeze loop while Ensnaring Spiders threaten isolated players.

evidence.source_name: The Tank Club Scrivener's Hall Guide

value.label: Room III / Valinna Execute
value.description: Valinna carries forward fire placement and Immolation Trap pressure while meteors and challenge-banner rolling boulders compress the remaining arena.

Lamikhai Enrage / Frost Trap
